messages:
maria: QuickSilver HW preview kickoff — partners shipped a 2-node rack for our EAP. NDA needs signoff, bench week tentatively May 9-13. Can ops/bench folks confirm owners? :rocket:

alex: I can own the perf harness + telemetry. Will need SSH creds and a sample model artifact (FP16/INT8 variants).

jin: Please add a short runbook for quantized variants. We saw weird tokenization drift last time when we used INT8 without the fused softmax kernel.

carla: I’ll handle partner logistics and travel paperwork. Tim (Quicksilver) — can you confirm rack power schedule and network VLANs? Also need copy of partner NDA link.

tim_quicksilver: @carla confirmed — rack available May 8 for early setup. VLANs are 10.42.0.0/16, reserved ports 16-24 for Redwood. NDA link: https://quicksilver.link/nda/rdw (partner portal). They want signed PDF by EOD Friday.

eng-bot: NDA doc updated: https://drive.redwood/team/partnerships/quicksilver-nda-v2.pdf (versioned). Reaction :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks. Bench targets proposal: 95p latency <= 180ms @ steady-state for 512 tokens, throughput target 70 tokens/s per GPU for our medium LLM baseline. We’ll run:
```
bench-config:
  model: rw-medium-fp16
  batch_sizes: [1,2,4,8]
  seq_len: 512
  warmup_tokens: 50k
  traces: [latency,p99,coldstart]
```

alex: Add KV-cache warmup and a small prefix cache test (prefix length 128) — that reduced variability on Ampere. Also include continuous batching disabled for the first run so we can measure single-request latencies.

jin: Upload sample payloads (chat + long generation) to the drive folder and flag which ones need detokenization checks. I’ll bring the quantized conversion script.

carla: Who’s going on-site from Redwood? Need names for guest access.

maria: On-site: alex, jin, me. Maybe one more SRE if we need to swap GPUs (TBD).

tim_quicksilver: Good — we’ll provide local instrument access and a power monitor. Preflight checklist requested by our lab ops: rack mounting, CSI cable mapping, admin VLAN, test IPs.

jin: Preflight quick list: sign NDA, provide SSH pubkeys, confirm model artifacts and config, upload payloads, schedule a 30m lab ops sync 48h before.

maria: Perfect. Carla — can you get NDA signed and confirm travel approvals? Alex/Jin please drop SSH keys and model link by Thursday so partner can pre-stage images.

carla: On it. I’ll collect signatures and ping finance for travel. Will schedule the 30m sync for May 6.

alex: Dropping SSH pubkey and model links to the drive now.

maria: Thanks team. Marking action owners: NDA (carla), perf harness (alex), quant/runbook (jin), partner comms (carla). Aiming for clean handoff by EOD Friday. :spiral_calendar:

eng-bot: Reminder set: channel reminder for "Quicksilver EAP preflight" on 2039001160 (48h before).
